question: Does the explicit two-term MLP4 -> three-source bank -> attention5 H7/H1/H6/H8 path transfer prospectively to unseen lexical combinations in the known-capable syntax?
data_status: Prospective to every exact holdout text and causal outcome. Lexical items were previously present only in a different capability-invalid construction test; their pairing with the parent syntax and all explicit-path outcomes are unopened.
population: All 64 rows for native A1/A2/P/C capability; the 32 answer-changing A1/A2 rows for causal path interventions.

frozen_program.writer: Down((Left_d-Left_b)*Right_b + Left_b*(Right_d-Right_b)) at resid5 on last+period+the

predictions.pred_a_native_capability: Every ordered A1, A2, P, and C cell passes the fixed native capability bars before any causal result is interpreted.
predictions.pred_b_writer_transfer: The writer arm has mean target recovery at least 0.20, positive A1/A2 mean recovery, and direction fraction at least 0.80 in each.
predictions.pred_c_four_head_path_transfer: The complete four-head arm retains at least 8% of writer mean recovery, has positive A1/A2 mean recovery, and direction fraction at least 0.75 in each.
predictions.pred_d_source_identity_transfer: The bank arm retains at least 95% of complete-four-head mean recovery and matches it within 0.125 scored logit on every row.
predictions.pred_e_four_head_compression_transfer: The four-head arm retains at least 70% of the all-nine-head attention5 arm.
predictions.pred_f_exact_coverage: All four arms produce all 32 target outcomes with finite logits within 20 model forward calls and 320 example evaluations.

terminal.screen: A-F pass: promote the explicit MLP4-bank-attention5 path as prospectively lexical/recombination stable in A1/A2 syntax.
terminal.null: The run is valid but B, C, D, or E fails: retain discovery-only scope.
terminal.invalid: Native capability, token/source alignment, instrument identity, finiteness, or coverage fails. No text, lexicon, arm, row, or threshold may change after outcomes open.

novelty: First prospective validation of an explicit factorized writer-to-source-to-head path for aspectual-anchor behavior.
